source.author: verg
source.text: Nec soli poenas dant sanguine Teucri; quondam etiam victis redit in praecordia virtus victoresque cadunt Danai: crudelis ubique luctus, ubique pavor, et plurima mortis imago.
source.text_original: Nec soli poenas dant sanguine Teucri; / quondam etiam victis redit in praecordia virtus / victoresque cadunt Danai: crudelis ubique / luctus, ubique pavor, et plurima mortis imago.
source.text_english: Nor do the Teucrians alone pay the penalty in blood; once even for the vanquished courage returns to their hearts, and the Danaans who had been victorious fall: cruel mourning everywhere, everywhere fear, and the grim presence of death in many forms.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: ilia, illa est uera bestia, cuius una iussione funditur ater ubique cruor: crudelis ubique luctus, ubique pauor et plurima mortis imago .
reuse.text_original: ilia, illa est uera bestia, cuius una iussione funditur ater ubique cruor: crudelis ubique luctus, ubique pauor et plurima mortis imago .
reuse.text_english: That is the true beast, at whose single command black blood is poured out everywhere: cruel mourning everywhere, everywhere dread, and death in many a form.
